text: Can you pull together every ticket number on Quarrendon Freight Lines you can find across Moss's notes? List each with where it comes from. Putting it in the weekly notes.
reply_text:
I replied to Dana in our DM. Moss's notes have two Quarrendon Freight Lines ticket numbers:

1. #PD-4492, from teams/team-north/digests/2025-10-05-north-sunday.md (Moss's "Sunday prep for Ruth", 5 Oct 2025). The Eau Claire gatehouse kiosk wasn't sending SMS bay assignments for the 04:00 shift at Dock Doors 14–18. It was patched on 4 Oct 2025.

2. #4419, from teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md (Moss's North cheat sheet, undated). Gatehouse barcode scanners couldn't read trailer tags at Door 14 on third shift. It was escalated to tier-2 for scanner firmware testing.

I also told her:
- Moss's other two notes on the account (the 14 Sep 2025 pipeline digest and the 23 Mar 2026 renewal check-in) have no ticket numbers.
- #4409, #4412 and FR-882 in Moss's Central digests belong to Central accounts, not this one.
- Marcus's intel note is about Quarendon Freightways, a different company that isn't our customer, so I left it out.
- I only checked Moss's files on the shared drive, not channel messages.

One mistake in my reply: the PD-4492 note says to archive the kiosk logs before the "14 Oct" maintenance window, and I didn't give the year. That was 14 Oct 2025, not today. Dana should know before it goes in the weekly notes.
